dedupe_keys.name: nces edge school locations and geocodes us

description: The Education Demographic and Geographic Estimates (EDGE) program of the US National Center for Education Statistics creates address geocodes (estimated latitude and longitude) and other geographic indicators for public schools, public local education agencies, private schools and postsecondary schools. Public school and district office geocodes are based on the Common Core of Data, NCES's annual administrative collection on enrolment, staffing and programmes, and the program also produces locale indicators, school district boundaries and American Community Survey indicators for school-age children. Coverage: the United States. Access: shapefile downloads and GIS web services from the EDGE site, with the mapED viewer. Licence: US federal government data; free. Caveats: locations are geocoded from addresses, so points may fall off the actual school building, and private school coverage depends on a separate survey. Simulation uses are school exposure to floods, wildfire and earthquakes, school-based shelter planning and accessibility analysis. Related records: the NYC building footprints and HIFLD Open, which also carried school layers.
